measurements.printParameters: Test Sample Printing Conditions: (p. 2; the conditions are drawn on the page image)
measurements.note: Flagged physically implausible on entry: the sheet prints a heat deflection of 190 °C at 0.455 MPa on printed test samples ("Test Sample Printing Conditions:", p. 2) and states no treatment, and advises drying the printed model "in an oven at a temperature of 120~130°C for 6~8 hours to improve the strength of the model" (p. 1). PET prints glassy, fibre-filled or not (D158, D176): a carbon-fibre PET bar that was not crystallised deflects at 74 to 100 °C (BASF Ultrafuse PET CF15 74 °C, Raise3D Industrial PET CF 87 °C before annealing and 175 °C after, Flashforge PET-CF 100 °C "not annealed"). 190 °C is a crystallised bar's, annealed or printed hot, which the page does not say this was. Kept as printed; it backs nothing.
